name: Test room 8 — crystals
notes: Unlockable abilities. Each player has a crystal in this room that only they can take, placed so they need their partner’s help. BLUE’S crystal (Jump Boost) floats on a slab four tiles up: Pink stands near it, Blue lands on Pink’s head (shoulder carry) and jumps up onto the slab. PINK’S crystal (Solid Light) is in a tunnel behind a door that is open only while the plate outside is held: Blue stands on the plate while Pink goes through and takes it (the plate keeps the door open for 6s after Blue steps off). Taking a crystal grants the ability at level 1; a later crystal for the same ability raises it a level (up to 3). Both players start with no abilities here. Teleport uses F (Blue) or , (Pink); G / M change the teleport action once you have level 2. A box explains each ability when you obtain it; Enter or a click closes it. Press N after finishing a room to carry your abilities on to the next. R restarts the room (crystals and abilities as at the start).
hint: Each of you has a crystal only you can take, and you need each other to reach them. Blue: stand on Pink’s head, jump to the slab. Pink: Blue holds the plate so you can go through the tunnel door.
